text: In a report dated 10 November 2013, the All Pakistan Private Schools Federation, which says it represents more than 152,000 institutions, decided against letting pupils read Malala Yousafzai's I Am Malala. The book was not to be included in the schools' curriculum or stocked in school libraries.
meta_description: I Am Malala by Malala Yousafzai: a 10 November 2013 report says the All Pakistan Private Schools Federation kept it out of curricula and libraries.
